search.title: Emeka Okafor

search.title: Jahlil Okafor
search.snippet: Jahlil Obika Okafor (/ˈdʒɑː liːl/; born December 15, 1995) is a Nigerian-American professional basketball player for Levanga Hokkaido of the B.League.
